messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "no fixed time of day"
set: ["no fixed time of day", "can be taken at any time of day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take at same time each day", "take at same time every day", "maintenance dose is not fixed", "take at around the same time each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "can be given with or without meals at any time of the day", "take for full prescribed length of time", "be sure caregivers know ahead of time", "take with food at the same time each day", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "kept in original carton until time of administration", "no specific antidote available"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "can be taken at any time of day",
    "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day",
    "take at same time each day",
    "take at same time every day",
    "take at around the same time each day",
    "taken at approximately the same time each day",
    "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals"
  ],
  "alias": "take at same time each day"
}
